not_found: The Vascular Access Society of Britain and Ireland ASM 2026 page (vasbi.org.uk/annual-scientific-meeting-2026/) lists no speakers yet (programme 'available soon'); no speaker class recorded.
VASBI's trainee representative and research and education lead roles are unfilled on the page. The patient representative is deliberately not listed.

No UK professional body for blood collection/phlebotomy with a readable named committee was found, so no blood collection people are recorded. Other vascular access bodies (for example nursing infusion societies) were not read in this session.
renalinterventions.net news article on the VASBI 2026 meeting returned 403, so not used.
LinkedIn matching not done: web search allowance exhausted in this session, so no profile could be verified.
